title: 3D FIBSEM CLEM Mouse Brain Tissue
author: Yumei Wu
materials: Dehydration in 100% ethanol for 5 minutes x3.
Infiltration in 75% Epon in propylene oxide overnight.
Infiltration in 100% Epon in propylene oxide overnight.

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse
steps.instruction: Inject a Ketamine/Xylazine cocktail (16 mg ml⁻¹ Ketamine, 0.8 mg ml⁻¹ Xylazine) to anesthetize the mouse.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse transcardially
steps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse with 37 °C pre‑warmed 4 % paraformaldehyde and 0.05 % glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (0.1 M Na₂HPO₄ + 0.1 M NaH₂PO₄, pH 7.4) at 5–6 ml min⁻¹ using a pump.

steps.title: Dissect brain and overnight fixation
steps.instruction: Dissect the brain, place it in the same fixative, and keep overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash brain in buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed brain 3 × 20 min in 0.1 M phosphate buffer.

steps.title: Section brain sagittally
steps.instruction: Sagittally cut the brain into 50 µm sections using a vibratome.

steps.title: Mount sections on slides
steps.instruction: Mount sections on glass slides in 0.1 M phosphate buffer and coverslip them.

steps.title: Fluorescence imaging and post‑fix selection
steps.instruction: Image sections on an Olympus SliceView VS200 slide scanner (Hamamatsu Orca‑Fusion camera, 40× Olympus UPlanXApo objective). Identify sections with abundant tdTomato puncta and post‑fix those in 2.5 % glutaraldehyde + 2 mM CaCl₂ (J.T. Baker) in 0.1 M sodium cacodylate buffer for 2–3 h on ice.

steps.title: Heavy metal staining series
steps.instruction: Perform sequential heavy‑metal staining:

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 2 % osmium tetroxide, 1.5 % potassium ferrocyanide, and 2 mM CaCl₂ in 0.1 M sodium cacodylate buffer for 1 h on ice.
Treat with thiocarbohydrazide (TCH) for 20 min at room temperature.
Second osmication: 2 % osmium tetroxide in water for 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate in 2 % aqueous uranyl acetate overnight at 4 °C.
Dehydrate in propylene oxide for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resin infiltration series
steps.instruction: Infiltrate sections with Epon resin:

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 25 % Epon (Embed‑812) in propylene oxide for several hours.
Incubate in 50 % Epon in propylene oxide for several hours.
Replace with fresh 100 % Epon for several additional hours.

steps.title: Embed sections on coverslip
steps.instruction: Mount sections onto 12‑mm glass coverslips in a drop of Epon, remove excess resin, and polymerize at 60 °C for 48 h.

steps.title: Attach sample to SEM mount
steps.instruction: Glue the coverslip bearing the Epon‑embedded brain section onto the aluminum SEM sample holder.

steps.title: Sputter coat with platinum
steps.instruction: Coat the sample en bloc with a 20 nm layer of platinum using a sputter coater (Ted Pella, Inc.).

steps.title: Load sample into FIBSEM
steps.instruction: Load the coated sample into a Crossbeam 550 FIB‑SEM workstation (SmartSEM, Zeiss) running Atlas engine 5 (Fibics).

steps.title: Locate region of interest
steps.instruction: Using the fluorescence light‑microscope image as a guide, relocate the dystrophic dopaminergic axon (large tdTomato puncta) on the SEM stage via SE2 detector (EHT 5 kV, probe 2 nA) at a working distance of 10 nm, referencing blood vessels, cell bodies, and axonal bundles in the dorsal striatum.

steps.title: Adjust stage for eucentric height
steps.instruction: Incline the stage to 54° and raise it to a working distance of 5 nm to achieve eucentric height and a coincident point.

steps.title: Define imaging area
steps.instruction: Set the imaging area to 80 × 50 µm covering the region of interest.

steps.title: Deposit protective platinum pad
steps.instruction: Deposit a 1 µm thick protective platinum layer on the ROI surface using the platinum gas‑injection system (GIS) and a FIB probe at 30 kV, 7 nA.

steps.title: Create autotune and tracking marks
steps.instruction: Mill and fill autotune and 3D‑tracking marks into the platinum pad with the FIB at 30 kV, 50 pA while using the carbon GIS.

steps.title: Deposit protective carbon pad
steps.instruction: Deposit a 1 µm thick carbon protective pad over the marks‑containing platinum pad using the carbon GIS and the FIB at 30 kV, 7 nA.

steps.title: Mill coarse trench
steps.instruction: Mill a coarse trench 40 µm deep using the FIB at 30 kV, 30 nA.

steps.title: Mill fine trench
steps.instruction: Refine the trench with the FIB at 30 kV, 3 nA.

steps.title: Mill imaging surface during tracking
steps.instruction: During 3D tracking, mill the imaging surface with the FIB at 30 kV, 700 pA.

steps.title: Set imaging detector parameters
steps.instruction: Configure imaging detectors and parameters:

substeps.instruction: Use the In‑lens detector (EHT 1.5 kV, probe 0.5 nA).
Set ESB detector grid bias to 1000 V and collector bias to 300 V.
Set dwell time to 0.5 µs and line averaging to 2.
Set imaging resolution to 8 nm pixel⁻¹ in X/Y, slice thickness 4 nm in Z (binned 2 on export), yielding an isotropic voxel size of 8 nm.

steps.title: Align, export, and segment images
steps.instruction: Align and export the image stack with Atlas 5 (Fibics), then process and 3‑D segment using DragonFly Pro software (Object Research Systems). All reagents unless noted are from EMS (Electron Microscopy Sciences, Hatfield, PA).
